targets.title: The Truth About Trading Your Spouse For A Mistress 💔
targets.author: Knight Vers
targets.text:
James Sexton is explaining why leaving a marriage for a mistress without fixing internal issues is simply job-hopping from your problems. Rather than addressing core relationship struggles constructively, people often create triangulated dynamics and repeat identical behavioral patterns. Because true self-reflection is avoided, the new romance eventually faces the exact same emotional dissatisfaction, proving that a new partner cannot cure an unexamined life.
#motivation #discipline #wisewords #inspiration #shortfeed #shorts #breakup

targets.title: ✦INTRADAY TRADER✦ What if the breakthrough is just 1 trade away? Don't quit early 👇
targets.author: Intraday trader
targets.text:
Trading consistency for beginners: why your first 100 trades are about learning, not getting rich, and why quitting before you finish your sample size is the most common mistake in intraday trading.
Most beginners expect profits from their first few trades. When the results don't come, they switch strategies or quit. But your first 100 trades are your training period: they teach you your strategy, your emotions and your mistakes. This video is for every intraday trader who feels like giving up too early and wants a clear plan for the first 100 trades.
